item.title: I Know We're in an AI Bubble Because Nobody Wants Me
item.description:
📝 There’s no guarantee that it’s even possible to find a good answer, so the process itself can be endlessly frustrating. I can never guarantee that I’ll find a solution, but my consolation is always that I have a better understanding of the world than when I started. The deepest satisfaction comes when I do finally find an approach that runs faster, or uses fewer resources.
🔗 Read more: https://petewarden.com/2025/11/29/i-know-were-in-an-ai-bubble-because-nobody-wants-me-%f0%9f%98%ad/
